name: Friendster
title: Was Friendster too early? No: execution, not timing
question: Was Friendster too early?
answer: Friendster (2002) pioneered the modern social network and grew to millions of users, but its pages slowed to a crawl as it grew. MySpace (2003) scaled past it in the same years, on the same broadband, and won. When a competitor succeeds at the same time with the same enablers, the enabler existed: this was execution.
verdict_reason: MySpace succeeded in the same window with the same technology.

constraint.name: Nothing was missing
constraint.detail: The enablers it needed already existed; something else killed it.

graveyard.name: Friendster
graveyard.how: Lost US users to MySpace by 2005; shut in 2015
